items.title: Betting on chip stocks remains the most crowded trade by far, BofA’s survey finds
items.summary: Investing.com -- Long global semiconductors remains the most crowded trade among investors, according to Bank of America’s November fund manager survey, though the share naming it has fallen sharply from its peak.

items.title: Bending Spoons (BSP) Stock May Be 16% Undervalued On AI Risk Warning
items.summary: Bending Spoons has seen its share price lose ground over the past month, and the key issue now is whether that pullback lines up with what the business is generating in cash. With a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate available, investors are increasingly asking if the current market price still reflects the underlying cash flows that the company can produce over time. items.title: Social Security Pays Nothing for the Month You Die, Even if You Die on the 31st. The Deposit That Arrives the Next Month Has to Go Back, and the Bank Returns It Whether or Not the Widow Has Spent It
items.summary: The deposit lands right after the funeral, and the bank can pull it back whether or not the money is still there. One widow's October 31 loss shows how a quiet Treasury process can bounce her bills, and what to do before it does.

items.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Bank of America (BAC) Online Banking Outages
items.summary: Major U.S. banks, including Bank of America, recently faced repeated online and mobile outages that disrupted customer access to accounts, transfers and check cashing, raising fresh questions about the reliability of core digital infrastructure. These recurring service interruptions put a spotlight on Bank of America's technology spending and resilience. items.title: Berkshire trims Bank of America, Capital One stakes, adds to Delta investment
items.summary: Investment.com -- Berkshire Hathaway reshuffled its equity portfolio in the third quarter, cutting its exposure to Bank of America and Capital One while increasing its investment in Delta Air Lines and building a new position in Italian technology company Bending Spoons, a regulatory filing showed on Monday.

items.title: Daniel Loeb’s Third Point Returned to Nvidia Stock Just Before Its Fall
items.summary: The fund’s third quarter filing shows a Nvidia stake of 1,500,000 shares.

items.title: Berkshire Boosts Lennar, Starts Bending Spoons, Trims Bank Of America In Q3
items.summary: According to the company’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday, the firm’s overall equity portfolio stood at roughly $304 billion across about 30 positions as of the end of the quarter.
